newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 15.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 15.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Drug prices rose an average 12 percent today.
- Oppositon parties Smallhoders and MDF accuse the ruling Socialist party that it wants to destroy the opposition.
- The head of the pension insurance self-government said a pension reform is inevitable but the question is what type of reform is needed.
- Former privatisation minister Tamas Suchman denied press reports that he is to meet Prime Minister Gyula Horn on Wednesday as the meeting took place on Tuesday.
